     2	
     3	import (
     4		"context"
     5		"errors"
     6		"os"
     7		"path/filepath"
     8		"strings"
     9		"sync"
    10		"time"
    11	)
    12	
    13	const workspaceLockRetryInterval = 25 * time.Millisecond
    14	
    15	type workspaceFileLock struct {
    16		file    *os.File
    17		release func() error
    18	}
    19	
    20	func acquireWorkspaceFileLock(ctx context.Context, root, lockPath string) (*workspaceFileLock, error) {
    21		root = filepath.Clean(root)
    22		lockPath = filepath.Clean(lockPath)
    23		if !pathContainedBy(root, lockPath) || lockPath == root {
    24			return nil, errors.New("lock path escapes its configured root")
    25		}
    26		if err := ensureContainedDirectory(root, filepath.Dir(lockPath)); err != nil {
    27			return nil, err
    28		}
    29		if info, err := os.Lstat(lockPath); err == nil {
    30			if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
    31				return nil, errors.New("lock path is a symlink or non-regular file")
    32			}
    33		} else if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
    34			return nil, err
    35		}
    36		file, err := os.OpenFile(lockPath, os.O_CREATE|os.O_RDWR, 0o600)
    37		if err != nil {
    38			return nil, err
    39		}
    40		info, err := file.Stat()
    41		if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
    42			_ = file.Close()
    43			return nil, errors.New("lock file is unavailable")
    44		}
    45		for {
    46			locked, lockErr := tryWorkspaceFileLock(file)
    47			if lockErr != nil {
    48				_ = file.Close()
    49				return nil, lockErr
    50			}
    51			if locked {
    52				break
    53			}
    54			select {
    55			case <-ctx.Done():
    56				_ = file.Close()
    57				return nil, ctx.Err()
    58			case <-time.After(workspaceLockRetryInterval):
    59			}
    60		}
    61		pathInfo, err := os.Lstat(lockPath)
    62		if err != nil || pathInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !pathInfo.Mode().IsRegular() || !os.SameFile(info, pathInfo) {
    63			_ = unlockWorkspaceFile(file)
    64			_ = file.Close()
    65			return nil, errors.New("lock file changed while it was acquired")
    66		}
    67		var once sync.Once
    68		var releaseErr error
    69		release := func() error {
    70			once.Do(func() {
    71				releaseErr = errors.Join(unlockWorkspaceFile(file), file.Close())
    72			})
    73			return releaseErr
    74		}
    75		return &workspaceFileLock{file: file, release: release}, nil
    76	}
    77	
    78	func (l *workspaceFileLock) Release() error {
    79		if l == nil || l.release == nil {
    80			return nil
    81		}
    82		return l.release()
    83	}
    84	
    85	func lockPathFor(root, namespace string, segments ...string) (string, error) {
    86		if strings.TrimSpace(namespace) == "" {
    87			return "", errors.New("lock namespace is empty")
    88		}
    89		parts := []string{root, ".locks", namespace}
    90		for _, segment := range segments {
    91			segment = strings.TrimSpace(segment)
    92			if segment == "" || segment == "." || segment == ".." || strings.ContainsAny(segment, `/\\`) {
    93				return "", errors.New("lock path segment is invalid")
    94			}
    95			parts = append(parts, segment)
    96		}
    97		if len(parts) == 3 {
    98			return "", errors.New("lock path has no identity segments")
    99		}
   100		parts[len(parts)-1] += ".lock"
   101		return filepath.Join(parts...), nil
   102	}

    25	func TestWorkspaceMaterializerClonesThenFetchesStableSessionCheckout(t *testing.T) {
    26		root := t.TempDir()
    27		cacheRoot := t.TempDir()
    28		targetID := uuid.New()
    29		execution, workload := workspaceTestWorkload(targetID)
    30		materializer := NewWorkspaceMaterializerWithCache(root, cacheRoot, targetID)
    31		materializer.resolver = workspaceResolver{"git.example.com": {{IP: net.ParseIP("93.184.216.34")}}}
    32		commands := make([]string, 0)
    33		configureWorkspaceTestNetwork(t, materializer, createWorkspaceTestSource(t), func(directory string, _ []string, arguments []string) {
    34			commands = append(commands, strings.Join(append([]string{directory}, arguments...), " "))
    35		})
    36	
    37		first, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
    38		if err != nil {
    39			t.Fatal(err)
    40		}
    41		if err := first.Release(); err != nil {
    42			t.Fatal(err)
    43		}
    44		second, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
    45		if err != nil {
    46			t.Fatal(err)
    47		}
    48		defer second.Release()
    49		if !first.Managed || first.Directory != second.Directory || first.RepositoryFingerprint == nil ||
    50			first.CurrentBranch == nil || *first.CurrentBranch != sessionBranch(workload.SessionID.String()) ||
    51			first.BaseCommit == nil || first.HeadCommit == nil {
    52			t.Fatalf("unexpected materialized Workspace: first=%#v second=%#v", first, second)
    53		}
    54		encodedCommands := strings.Join(commands, "\n")
    55		if !strings.Contains(encodedCommands, "http.followRedirects=false") ||
    56			!strings.Contains(encodedCommands, "http.curloptResolve=+git.example.com:443:93.184.216.34") {
    57			t.Fatalf("Git network commands were not DNS-pinned with redirects disabled: %s", encodedCommands)
    58		}
    59	}

    92		if err != nil {
    93			t.Fatal(err)
    94		}

    96		assertWorkspaceTestFile(
    97			t,
    98			filepath.Join(recovered.Directory, "preserved-untracked.txt"),
    99			"durable git workspace\n",
   100		)
   101		for _, path := range []string{backup, staging} {
   102			if _, err := os.Lstat(path); !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
   103				t.Fatalf("interrupted Git Workspace residue survived at %s: %v", path, err)
   104			}
   105		}
   106	}

   108	func gitCommandArguments(arguments []string) []string {
   109		for len(arguments) >= 2 && arguments[0] == "-c" {
   110			arguments = arguments[2:]
   111		}
   112		return arguments
   113	}
   114	
   115	func flattenGitCommands(commands [][]string) []string {
   116		flattened := make([]string, 0)
   117		for _, command := range commands {
   118			flattened = append(flattened, command...)
   119		}
   120		return flattened
   121	}

   173	func TestWorkspaceInspectionDetectsGitAndGeneratedFileChanges(t *testing.T) {
   174		directory := t.TempDir()
   175		runTestGit(t, directory, "init", "-b", "main")
   176		runTestGit(t, directory, "config", "user.email", "worker@example.com")
   177		runTestGit(t, directory, "config", "user.name", "Synara Worker")
   178		tracked := filepath.Join(directory, "tracked.txt")
   179		if err := os.WriteFile(tracked, []byte("baseline\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
   180			t.Fatal(err)
   181		}
   182		runTestGit(t, directory, "add", "tracked.txt")
   183		runTestGit(t, directory, "commit", "-m", "baseline")
   184	
   185		materializer := NewWorkspaceMaterializer(t.TempDir())
   186		clean, err := materializer.Inspect(context.Background(), WorkspaceMaterialization{
   187			Directory: directory, Managed: true,
   188		})
   189		if err != nil {
   190			t.Fatal(err)
   191		}
   192		if clean.Dirty || clean.CurrentBranch == nil || *clean.CurrentBranch != "main" || clean.HeadCommit == nil {
   193			t.Fatalf("unexpected clean Workspace inspection: %#v", clean)
   194		}
   195		if err := os.WriteFile(tracked, []byte("changed\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
   196			t.Fatal(err)
   197		}
   198		dirty, err := materializer.Inspect(context.Background(), WorkspaceMaterialization{
   199			Directory: directory, Managed: true,
   200		})
   201		if err != nil {
   202			t.Fatal(err)
   203		}
   204		if !dirty.Dirty || dirty.CurrentBranch == nil || dirty.HeadCommit == nil {
   205			t.Fatalf("tracked changes were not reported as dirty: %#v", dirty)
   206		}
   207	
   208		generatedDirectory := t.TempDir()
   209		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(generatedDirectory, "generated.txt"), []byte("output"), 0o600); err != nil {
   210			t.Fatal(err)
   211		}
   212		generated, err := materializer.Inspect(context.Background(), WorkspaceMaterialization{
   213			Directory: generatedDirectory, Managed: true,
   214		})
   215		if err != nil {
   216			t.Fatal(err)
   217		}
   218		if !generated.Dirty || generated.CurrentBranch != nil || generated.HeadCommit != nil {
   219			t.Fatalf("generated files in a non-Git Workspace were not reported as dirty: %#v", generated)
   220		}
   221	}

   223	func TestWorkspaceMaterializerUsesAskPassWithoutLeakingCredential(t *testing.T) {
   224		root := t.TempDir()
   225		t.Setenv("TMPDIR", root)
   226		targetID := uuid.New()
   227		execution, workload := workspaceTestWorkload(targetID)
   228		workload.RepositoryURL = stringPointer("https://git.example.com/team/private.git")
   229		materializer := NewWorkspaceMaterializerWithCache(root, t.TempDir(), targetID)
   230		materializer.resolver = workspaceResolver{"git.example.com": {{IP: net.ParseIP("93.184.216.34")}}}
   231		materializer.executable = func() (string, error) { return "/usr/local/bin/synara-agentd", nil }
   232		secret := "private-git-token"
   233		var environments [][]string
   234		var commands [][]string
   235		var socketPath string
   236		configureWorkspaceTestNetwork(t, materializer, createWorkspaceTestSource(t), func(_ string, environment, arguments []string) {
   237			environments = append(environments, append([]string(nil), environment...))
   238			commands = append(commands, append([]string(nil), arguments...))
   239			for _, value := range environment {
   240				if strings.HasPrefix(value, GitAskPassSocketEnvironment+"=") {
   241					socketPath = strings.TrimPrefix(value, GitAskPassSocketEnvironment+"=")
   242				}
   243			}
   244		})
   245		credential := &WorkspaceGitCredential{HTTPS: &GitHTTPSCredential{Host: "git.example.com", Username: "git-user", Token: secret}}
   246		materialized, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, credential)
   247		if err != nil {
   248			t.Fatal(err)
   249		}
   250		defer materialized.Release()
   251		if socketPath == "" {
   252			t.Fatal("authenticated Git commands omitted the AskPass socket")
   253		}
   254		if pathContainedBy(root, socketPath) {
   255			t.Fatalf("AskPass socket was created inside the Workspace root: %s", socketPath)
   256		}
   257		encodedEnvironment := strings.Join(flattenGitCommands(environments), "\n")
   258		encodedCommands := strings.Join(flattenGitCommands(commands), "\n")
   259		if strings.Contains(encodedEnvironment, secret) || strings.Contains(encodedCommands, secret) {
   260			t.Fatalf("Git Credential leaked into environment or argv: env=%s argv=%s", encodedEnvironment, encodedCommands)
   261		}
   262		if !strings.Contains(encodedEnvironment, "GIT_ASKPASS=/usr/local/bin/synara-agentd") ||
   263			!strings.Contains(encodedEnvironment, "GIT_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force") {
   264			t.Fatalf("authenticated Git commands omitted AskPass configuration: %s", encodedEnvironment)
   265		}
   266		for index, command := range commands {
   267			arguments := gitCommandArguments(command)
   268			if len(arguments) == 0 {
   269				continue
   270			}
   271			environment := strings.Join(environments[index], "\n")
   272			usesAskPass := strings.Contains(environment, GitAskPassSocketEnvironment+"=")
   273			isNetworkFetch := false
   274			for _, argument := range command {
   275				if strings.HasPrefix(argument, "http.curloptResolve=") {
   276					isNetworkFetch = true
   277				}
   278			}
   279			if isNetworkFetch && !usesAskPass {
   280				t.Fatal("authenticated cache Fetch did not receive AskPass")
   281			}
   282			if !isNetworkFetch && usesAskPass {
   283				t.Fatalf("local Git command %q received the Git Credential environment", arguments[0])
   284			}
   285		}
   286		if _, err := os.Stat(socketPath); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
   287			t.Fatalf("AskPass socket survived Workspace preparation: %v", err)
   288		}
   289	}

   317	func TestWorkspaceMaterializerRedactsCredentialFromGitError(t *testing.T) {
   318		secret := "private-token-in-stderr"
   319		targetID := uuid.New()
   320		execution, workload := workspaceTestWorkload(targetID)
   321		workload.RepositoryURL = stringPointer("https://git.example.com/team/private.git")
   322		materializer := NewWorkspaceMaterializerWithCache(t.TempDir(), t.TempDir(), targetID)
   323		materializer.resolver = workspaceResolver{"git.example.com": {{IP: net.ParseIP("93.184.216.34")}}}
   324		materializer.executable = func() (string, error) { return "/usr/local/bin/synara-agentd", nil }
   325		realRun := materializer.runGitCommand
   326		materializer.runGit = func(ctx context.Context, directory string, environment []string, arguments ...string) (string, error) {
   327			for _, argument := range arguments {
   328				if strings.HasPrefix(argument, "http.curloptResolve=") {
   329					return "", errors.New("remote rejected token " + secret)
   330				}
   331			}
   332			if commandArguments := gitCommandArguments(arguments); len(commandArguments) > 0 && commandArguments[0] == "fetch" {
   333				return "", errors.New("remote rejected token " + secret)
   334			}
   335			return realRun(ctx, directory, environment, arguments...)
   336		}
   337		_, err := materializer.Materialize(
   338			context.Background(), execution, workload,
   339			&WorkspaceGitCredential{HTTPS: &GitHTTPSCredential{Host: "git.example.com", Username: "git-user", Token: secret}},
   340		)
   341		if err == nil {
   342			t.Fatal("Workspace Clone failure was not returned")
   343		}
   344		if strings.Contains(err.Error(), secret) {
   345			t.Fatalf("Git Credential leaked through Workspace failure: %v", err)
   346		}
   347	}

   349	func TestGitEnvironmentDropsAmbientCredentials(t *testing.T) {
   350		t.Setenv("GITHUB_TOKEN", "github-secret")
   351		t.Setenv("SSH_AUTH_SOCK", "/tmp/agent.sock")
   352		t.Setenv("AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY", "aws-secret")
   353		encoded := strings.Join(gitEnvironment(nil), "\n")
   354		for _, secret := range []string{"github-secret", "/tmp/agent.sock", "aws-secret"} {
   355			if strings.Contains(encoded, secret) {
   356				t.Fatalf("ambient Credential leaked into Git environment: %s", encoded)
   357			}
   358		}
   359		for _, required := range []string{"GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0", "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null", "GIT_ASKPASS=/bin/false"} {
   360			if !strings.Contains(encoded, required) {
   361				t.Fatalf("Git isolation environment omitted %s: %s", required, encoded)
   362			}
   363		}
   364	}

   366	func runTestGit(t *testing.T, directory string, arguments ...string) {
   367		t.Helper()

   369		command.Dir = directory
   370		command.Env = append(os.Environ(), "LC_ALL=C", "LANG=C", "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1")
   371		if output, err := command.CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
   372			t.Fatalf("git %v failed: %v: %s", arguments, err, output)
   373		}
   374	}

    42		realRun := materializer.runGitCommand
    43		sourceURL := (&url.URL{Scheme: "file", Path: filepath.ToSlash(source)}).String()
    44		var networkFetches atomic.Int32
    45		materializer.runGit = func(
    46			ctx context.Context,
    47			directory string,
    48			environment []string,
    49			arguments ...string,
    50		) (string, error) {
    51			if observe != nil {
    52				observe(directory, append([]string(nil), environment...), append([]string(nil), arguments...))
    53			}
    54			networkCommand := false
    55			for _, argument := range arguments {
    56				if strings.HasPrefix(argument, "http.curloptResolve=") {
    57					networkCommand = true
    58					break
    59				}
    60			}
    61			commandArguments := gitCommandArguments(arguments)
    62			if networkCommand && len(commandArguments) > 0 && commandArguments[0] == "fetch" {
    63				networkFetches.Add(1)
    64				refspec := commandArguments[len(commandArguments)-1]
    65				return realRun(
    66					ctx, directory, environment,
    67					"-c", "protocol.file.allow=always", "fetch", "--prune", "--no-tags", "--", sourceURL, refspec,
    68				)
    69			}
    70			return realRun(ctx, directory, environment, arguments...)
    71		}
    72		return &networkFetches
    73	}

    85	func TestWorkspaceCacheMaterializesPrivateWorktreeAndFetchesEveryTurn(t *testing.T) {
    86		workspaceRoot := t.TempDir()
    87		cacheRoot := t.TempDir()
    88		targetID := uuid.New()
    89		execution, workload := workspaceTestWorkload(targetID)
    90		materializer := NewWorkspaceMaterializerWithCache(workspaceRoot, cacheRoot, targetID)
    91		materializer.resolver = workspaceResolver{"git.example.com": {{IP: net.ParseIP("93.184.216.34")}}}
    92		var observedCommands []string
    93		networkFetches := configureWorkspaceTestNetwork(t, materializer, createWorkspaceTestSource(t), func(_ string, _ []string, arguments []string) {
    94			observedCommands = append(observedCommands, strings.Join(arguments, " "))
    95		})
    96	
    97		first, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
    98		if err != nil {
    99			t.Fatal(err)
   100		}
   101		if !first.Managed || first.LogicalRoot == "" || first.GitDir == "" || first.Directory != filepath.Join(first.LogicalRoot, "checkout") {
   102			t.Fatalf("unexpected private Workspace materialization: %#v", first)
   103		}
   104		gitFileInfo, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(first.Directory, ".git"))
   105		if err != nil || !gitFileInfo.Mode().IsRegular() || gitFileInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
   106			t.Fatalf("checkout .git is not a regular gitfile: info=%v err=%v", gitFileInfo, err)
   107		}
   108		commonDir := strings.TrimSpace(runTestGitOutput(t, first.Directory, "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir"))
   109		if !sameExistingPath(commonDir, first.GitDir) {
   110			t.Fatalf("checkout common-dir is not private: %s != %s", commonDir, first.GitDir)
   111		}
   112		firstDirectory := first.Directory
   113		if err := first.Release(); err != nil {
   114			t.Fatal(err)
   115		}
   116	
   117		second, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
   118		if err != nil {
   119			t.Fatal(err)
   120		}
   121		if second.Directory != firstDirectory || networkFetches.Load() != 2 {
   122			t.Fatalf("warm Workspace was not reused with a fresh Fetch: directory=%s fetches=%d", second.Directory, networkFetches.Load())
   123		}
   124		if err := second.Release(); err != nil {
   125			t.Fatal(err)
   126		}
   127	
   128		encodedCommands := strings.Join(observedCommands, "\n")
   129		for _, forbidden := range []string{"clone --local", "clone --shared", "clone --reference"} {
   130			if strings.Contains(encodedCommands, forbidden) {
   131				t.Fatalf("private Git materialization used forbidden local sharing flag %s: %s", forbidden, encodedCommands)
   132			}
   133		}
   134		if !strings.Contains(encodedCommands, "protocol.file.allow=always") || !strings.Contains(encodedCommands, "file://") {
   135			t.Fatalf("private Git materialization did not use controlled file transport: %s", encodedCommands)
   136		}
   137		if err := rejectGitObjectAlternates(second.GitDir); err != nil {
   138			t.Fatal(err)
   139		}
   140		if err := os.RemoveAll(cacheRoot); err != nil {
   141			t.Fatal(err)
   142		}
   143		runTestGit(t, second.Directory, "cat-file", "-e", "HEAD^{commit}")
   144	}

   146	func TestWorkspaceLockCoversConcurrentTurns(t *testing.T) {
   147		workspaceRoot := t.TempDir()
   148		cacheRoot := t.TempDir()
   149		targetID := uuid.New()
   150		execution, workload := workspaceTestWorkload(targetID)
   151		materializer := NewWorkspaceMaterializerWithCache(workspaceRoot, cacheRoot, targetID)
   152		materializer.resolver = workspaceResolver{"git.example.com": {{IP: net.ParseIP("93.184.216.34")}}}
   153		configureWorkspaceTestNetwork(t, materializer, createWorkspaceTestSource(t), nil)
   154		first, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
   155		if err != nil {
   156			t.Fatal(err)
   157		}
   158		type result struct {
   159			materialized WorkspaceMaterialization
   160			err          error
   161		}
   162		resultChannel := make(chan result, 1)
   163		go func() {
   164			materialized, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
   165			resultChannel <- result{materialized: materialized, err: err}
   166		}()
   167		select {
   168		case outcome := <-resultChannel:
   169			t.Fatalf("second Turn entered the Workspace before release: %v", outcome.err)
   170		case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
   171		}
   172		if err := first.Release(); err != nil {
   173			t.Fatal(err)
   174		}
   175		select {
   176		case outcome := <-resultChannel:
   177			if outcome.err != nil {
   178				t.Fatal(outcome.err)
   179			}
   180			_ = outcome.materialized.Release()
   181		case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
   182			t.Fatal("second Turn did not acquire the released Workspace lock")
   183		}
   184	}

   223	func TestWorkspaceCacheReconciliationRestoresCommittedBackupAndDiscardsStaging(t *testing.T) {
   224		workspaceRoot := t.TempDir()
   225		cacheRoot := t.TempDir()
   226		targetID := uuid.New()
   227		execution, workload := workspaceTestWorkload(targetID)
   228		materializer := NewWorkspaceMaterializerWithCache(workspaceRoot, cacheRoot, targetID)
   229		materializer.resolver = workspaceResolver{"git.example.com": {{IP: net.ParseIP("93.184.216.34")}}}
   230		networkFetches := configureWorkspaceTestNetwork(t, materializer, createWorkspaceTestSource(t), nil)
   231	
   232		first, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
   233		if err != nil {
   234			t.Fatal(err)
   235		}
   236		cache := first.cache
   237		if err := first.Release(); err != nil {
   238			t.Fatal(err)
   239		}
   240	
   241		backup := filepath.Join(cache.Root, ".repo.git.backup-"+uuid.NewString())
   242		staging := filepath.Join(cache.Root, ".repo.git.staging-"+uuid.NewString())
   243		if err := os.Rename(cache.RepoGit, backup); err != nil {
   244			t.Fatal(err)
   245		}
   246		if err := os.Mkdir(staging, 0o700); err != nil {
   247			t.Fatal(err)
   248		}
   249		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(staging, "partial"), []byte("not committed\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
   250			t.Fatal(err)
   251		}
   252	
   253		second, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
   254		if err != nil {
   255			t.Fatal(err)
   256		}
   257		defer second.Release()
   258		if err := materializer.validateBareRepository(context.Background(), cache.RepoGit, *workload.RepositoryURL); err != nil {
   259			t.Fatalf("restored Git cache is invalid: %v", err)
   260		}
   261		for _, residue := range []string{backup, staging} {
   262			if _, err := os.Lstat(residue); !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
   263				t.Fatalf("Git cache reconciliation left residue %s: %v", residue, err)
   264			}
   265		}
   266		if networkFetches.Load() != 2 {
   267			t.Fatalf("restored Git cache was not refreshed: fetches=%d", networkFetches.Load())
   268		}
   269	}

   313	func TestWorkspaceCacheReconciliationCancellationPreservesCommittedBackup(t *testing.T) {
   314		workspaceRoot := t.TempDir()
   315		cacheRoot := t.TempDir()
   316		targetID := uuid.New()
   317		execution, workload := workspaceTestWorkload(targetID)
   318		materializer := NewWorkspaceMaterializerWithCache(workspaceRoot, cacheRoot, targetID)
   319		materializer.resolver = workspaceResolver{"git.example.com": {{IP: net.ParseIP("93.184.216.34")}}}
   320		configureWorkspaceTestNetwork(t, materializer, createWorkspaceTestSource(t), nil)
   321	
   322		first, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
   323		if err != nil {
   324			t.Fatal(err)
   325		}
   326		cache := first.cache
   327		if err := first.Release(); err != nil {
   328			t.Fatal(err)
   329		}
   330	
   331		backup := filepath.Join(cache.Root, ".repo.git.backup-"+uuid.NewString())
   332		staging := filepath.Join(cache.Root, ".repo.git.staging-"+uuid.NewString())
   333		if err := os.Rename(cache.RepoGit, backup); err != nil {
   334			t.Fatal(err)
   335		}
   336		if err := os.Mkdir(staging, 0o700); err != nil {
   337			t.Fatal(err)
   338		}
   339		sentinel := filepath.Join(backup, "preserve-on-cancel")
   340		if err := os.WriteFile(sentinel, []byte("preserve\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
   341			t.Fatal(err)
   342		}
   343	
   344		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
   345		originalRunGit := materializer.runGit
   346		materializer.runGit = func(
   347			commandContext context.Context,
   348			directory string,
   349			environment []string,
   350			arguments ...string,
   351		) (string, error) {
   352			cancel()
   353			return originalRunGit(commandContext, directory, environment, arguments...)
   354		}
   355		err = materializer.reconcileCacheRepository(ctx, cache, *workload.RepositoryURL)
   356		if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
   357			t.Fatalf("canceled Git cache reconciliation returned %v", err)
   358		}
   359		if content, err := os.ReadFile(sentinel); err != nil || string(content) != "preserve\n" {
   360			t.Fatalf("canceled reconciliation deleted the committed backup: %q, %v", content, err)
   361		}
   362		if _, err := os.Lstat(staging); err != nil {
   363			t.Fatalf("canceled reconciliation deleted orphan staging before a safe decision: %v", err)
   364		}
   365	}

   367	func TestWorkspaceLayoutSeparatesExecutionTargetsAndPreservesLegacyData(t *testing.T) {
   368		workspaceRoot := t.TempDir()
   369		cacheRoot := t.TempDir()
   370		execution, workload := workspaceTestWorkload(uuid.New())
   371		firstTarget := execution.ExecutionTargetID
   372		secondTarget := uuid.New()
   373		firstMaterializer := NewWorkspaceMaterializerWithCache(workspaceRoot, cacheRoot, firstTarget)
   374		secondMaterializer := NewWorkspaceMaterializerWithCache(workspaceRoot, cacheRoot, secondTarget)
   375		firstLayout, err := firstMaterializer.resolveWorkspaceLayout(execution, workload)
   376		if err != nil {
   377			t.Fatal(err)
   378		}
   379		execution.ExecutionTargetID = secondTarget
   380		secondLayout, err := secondMaterializer.resolveWorkspaceLayout(execution, workload)
   381		if err != nil {
   382			t.Fatal(err)
   383		}
   384		if firstLayout.Root == secondLayout.Root {
   385			t.Fatal("different Execution Targets reused one Workspace path")
   386		}
   387		legacyFile := filepath.Join(firstLayout.LegacyRoot, "uncheckpointed.txt")
   388		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(legacyFile), 0o700); err != nil {
   389			t.Fatal(err)
   390		}
   391		if err := os.WriteFile(legacyFile, []byte("keep"), 0o600); err != nil {
   392			t.Fatal(err)
   393		}
   394		workload.RepositoryURL = nil
   395		execution.ExecutionTargetID = firstTarget
   396		if _, err := firstMaterializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil); err == nil {
   397			t.Fatal("legacy Workspace with uncheckpointed data was silently replaced")
   398		}
   399		if content, err := os.ReadFile(legacyFile); err != nil || string(content) != "keep" {
   400			t.Fatalf("legacy Workspace data was not preserved: %q err=%v", content, err)
   401		}
   402	}

    28	func TestDaemonRestoresSnapshotBeforeProviderAndReusesUnchangedCheckpoint(t *testing.T) {
    29		t.Setenv("GO_WANT_AGENTD_DRAIN_HELPER", "1")
    30		t.Setenv("AGENTD_DRAIN_HELPER_DELAY", "1ms")
    31		executionID := uuid.New()
    32		tenantID := uuid.New()
    33		organizationID := uuid.New()
    34		projectID := uuid.New()
    35		sessionID := uuid.New()
    36		turnID := uuid.New()
    37		workspaceID := uuid.New()
    38		workerID := uuid.New()
    39		checkpointID := uuid.New()
    40		artifactID := uuid.New()
    41		lease := executions.Lease{
    42			ExecutionID: executionID, TenantID: tenantID, WorkerID: workerID,
    43			Generation: 2, LeaseToken: "lease-token", ExpiresAt: time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
    44		}
    45		source := t.TempDir()
    46		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(source, "restored.txt"), []byte("checkpoint payload\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
    47			t.Fatal(err)
    48		}
    49		candidate, err := captureWorkspaceCheckpoint(
    50			context.Background(),
    51			executions.Execution{ID: uuid.New(), Generation: 1},
    52			WorkspaceMaterialization{Directory: source, Managed: true},
    53			WorkspaceInspection{Dirty: true},
    54		)
    55		if err != nil {
    56			t.Fatal(err)
    57		}
    58		defer candidate.Cleanup()
    59		archive, err := os.ReadFile(candidate.ArtifactPath)
    60		if err != nil {
    61			t.Fatal(err)
    62		}
    63		digest := sha256.Sum256(archive)
    64		sha := hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
    65		archiveSize := int64(len(archive))
    66		checkpoint := executions.WorkspaceCheckpoint{
    67			ID: checkpointID, WorkspaceID: workspaceID, SessionID: sessionID, TurnID: &turnID,
    68			ExecutionID: uuid.New(), Generation: 1, IdempotencyKey: "previous-snapshot",
    69			Strategy: "snapshot", Status: "ready", ArtifactID: &artifactID,
    70			Manifest: candidate.Manifest, FileCount: &candidate.FileCount,
    71			TotalBytes: &candidate.TotalBytes, SHA256: &sha,
    72		}
    73		var state struct {
    74			sync.Mutex
    75			order []string
    76			ready executions.WorkspaceReadyInput
    77		}
    78		var server *httptest.Server
    79		server = httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(response http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
    80			base := "/v1/workers/executions/" + executionID.String() + "/"
    81			switch request.URL.Path {
    82			case base + "workspace/checkpoints/" + checkpointID.String() + "/artifact/download":
    83				state.Lock()
    84				state.order = append(state.order, "checkpoint.download.grant")
    85				state.Unlock()
    86				response.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
    87				_, _ = io.WriteString(response, `{"artifact":{"id":"`+artifactID.String()+`","sizeBytes":`+fmt.Sprint(archiveSize)+`,"sha256":"`+sha+`"},"url":"`+server.URL+`/checkpoint-content","expiresAt":"2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"}`)
    88			case "/checkpoint-content":
    89				state.Lock()
    90				state.order = append(state.order, "checkpoint.download.content")
    91				state.Unlock()
    92				response.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/x-tar")
    93				_, _ = response.Write(archive)
    94			case base + "workspace/ready":
    95				if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&state.ready); err != nil {
    96					http.Error(response, "invalid Workspace ready payload", http.StatusBadRequest)
    97					return
    98				}
    99				state.Lock()
   100				state.order = append(state.order, "workspace.ready")
   101				state.Unlock()
   102				response.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
   103			case base + "start":
   104				state.Lock()
   105				state.order = append(state.order, "execution.start")
   106				state.Unlock()
   107				response.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
   108			case base + "complete":
   109				state.Lock()
   110				state.order = append(state.order, "execution.complete")
   111				state.Unlock()
   112				response.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
   113			default:
   114				http.Error(response, "unexpected path", http.StatusNotFound)
   115			}
   116		}))
   117		defer server.Close()
   118		controlPlaneURL, err := url.Parse(server.URL)
   119		if err != nil {
   120			t.Fatal(err)
   121		}
   122		root := t.TempDir()
   123		cfg := Config{
   124			ControlPlaneURL: controlPlaneURL, TargetKind: platform.TargetLocal,
   125			RunnerCommand:  agentdDrainRunnerTestCommand(),
   126			RunnerProtocol: RunnerProtocolV1, WorkspaceRoot: root, PollInterval: time.Millisecond,
   127			HeartbeatInterval: time.Hour, LeaseRenewInterval: time.Hour, DrainTimeout: time.Second,
   128			RequestTimeout: time.Second, ArtifactTimeout: time.Second, RunnerMessageBytes: 1 << 20,
   129		}
   130		client := NewClient(cfg)
   131		client.workerToken = "worker-token"
   132		daemon := &Daemon{
   133			config: cfg, client: client, runner: NewRunner(cfg),
   134			logger: slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(io.Discard, nil)),
   135		}
   136		execution := executions.Execution{ID: executionID, TenantID: tenantID, TurnID: turnID, Generation: lease.Generation}
   137		workload := executions.Workload{
   138			TenantID: tenantID, OrganizationID: organizationID, ProjectID: projectID,
   139			SessionID: sessionID, TurnID: turnID, RemoteWorkspaceID: &workspaceID,
   140			RestoreCheckpointID: &checkpointID, RestoreCheckpoint: &checkpoint,
   141			Provider: "codex", InputText: "continue", DefaultBranch: "main",
   142		}
   143		if err := daemon.runExecution(context.Background(), execution, lease, workload, nil); err != nil {
   144			t.Fatal(err)
   145		}
   146		workspace := filepath.Join(
   147			root, "v2", uuid.Nil.String(), tenantID.String(), projectID.String(), sessionID.String(), workspaceID.String(), "checkout",
   148		)
   149		content, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(workspace, "restored.txt"))
   150		if err != nil || string(content) != "checkpoint payload\n" {
   151			t.Fatalf("Provider did not receive the restored Workspace: %q err=%v", content, err)
   152		}
   153		state.Lock()
   154		defer state.Unlock()
   155		expectedOrder := []string{
   156			"checkpoint.download.grant", "checkpoint.download.content", "workspace.ready",
   157			"execution.start", "execution.complete",
   158		}
   159		if !reflect.DeepEqual(state.order, expectedOrder) {
   160			t.Fatalf("unexpected restore lifecycle order: %#v", state.order)
   161		}
   162		if state.ready.RestoredCheckpointID == nil || *state.ready.RestoredCheckpointID != checkpointID {
   163			t.Fatalf("Workspace restore was not reported: %#v", state.ready)
   164		}

   167	func TestDaemonPreparesManagedWorkspaceBeforeStartingProvider(t *testing.T) {
   168		t.Setenv("GO_WANT_AGENTD_DRAIN_HELPER", "1")
   169		t.Setenv("AGENTD_DRAIN_HELPER_DELAY", "1ms")
   170		executionID := uuid.New()
   171		tenantID := uuid.New()
   172		workerID := uuid.New()
   173		workspaceID := uuid.New()
   174		gitGrantID := uuid.New()
   175		checkpointID := uuid.New()
   176		artifactID := uuid.New()
   177		lease := executions.Lease{
   178			ExecutionID: executionID, TenantID: tenantID, WorkerID: workerID,
   179			Generation: 1, LeaseToken: "lease-token", ExpiresAt: time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
   180		}
   181		fingerprint, branch := stringPointer("a"+strings.Repeat("b", 63)), stringPointer("synara/session-test")
   182		baseCommit, headCommit := stringPointer(strings.Repeat("c", 40)), stringPointer(strings.Repeat("d", 40))
   183		var state struct {
   184			sync.Mutex
   185			order         []string
   186			ready         executions.WorkspaceReadyInput
   187			dirty         executions.WorkspaceDirtyInput
   188			checkpoint    executions.CreateWorkspaceCheckpointInput
   189			requestBodies []string
   190		}
   191		var server *httptest.Server
   192		server = httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(response http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
   193			base := "/v1/workers/executions/" + executionID.String() + "/"
   194			requestBody, _ := io.ReadAll(request.Body)
   195			request.Body = io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(string(requestBody)))
   196			state.Lock()
   197			state.requestBodies = append(state.requestBodies, string(requestBody))
   198			state.Unlock()
   199			switch request.URL.Path {
   200			case "/checkpoint-upload":
   201				state.Lock()
   202				state.order = append(state.order, "checkpoint.upload")
   203				state.Unlock()
   204				response.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
   205			case base + "credential-grants/" + gitGrantID.String() + "/resolve":
   206				state.Lock()
   207				state.order = append(state.order, "git.resolve")
   208				state.Unlock()
   209				response.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
   210				_, _ = io.WriteString(response, `{"grantId":"`+gitGrantID.String()+`","bindingKind":"git_fetch","purpose":"git","provider":"git","credentialType":"https_token","selector":"https://git.example.com/team/repository.git","payload":{"host":"git.example.com","username":"git-user","token":"git-secret-token"}}`)
   211			case base + "workspace/ready":
   212				var input executions.WorkspaceReadyInput
   213				if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&input); err != nil {
   214					http.Error(response, "invalid Workspace ready payload", http.StatusBadRequest)
   215					return
   216				}
   217				state.Lock()
   218				state.ready = input
   219				state.order = append(state.order, "workspace.ready")
   220				state.Unlock()
   221				response.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
   222			case base + "workspace/dirty":
   223				var input executions.WorkspaceDirtyInput
   224				if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&input); err != nil {
   225					http.Error(response, "invalid Workspace dirty payload", http.StatusBadRequest)
   226					return
   227				}
   228				state.Lock()
   229				state.dirty = input
   230				state.order = append(state.order, "workspace.dirty")
   231				state.Unlock()
   232				response.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
   233			case base + "workspace/checkpoints":
   234				var input executions.CreateWorkspaceCheckpointInput
   235				if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&input); err != nil {
   236					http.Error(response, "invalid Checkpoint payload", http.StatusBadRequest)
   237					return
   238				}
   239				state.Lock()
   240				state.checkpoint = input
   241				state.order = append(state.order, "checkpoint.create")
   242				state.Unlock()
   243				response.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
   244				_, _ = io.WriteString(response, `{"id":"`+checkpointID.String()+`","status":"pending"}`)
   245			case base + "artifacts":
   246				state.Lock()
   247				state.order = append(state.order, "checkpoint.artifact.create")
   248				state.Unlock()
   249				response.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
   250				_, _ = io.WriteString(response, `{"artifact":{"id":"`+artifactID.String()+`"},"method":"PUT","url":"`+server.URL+`/checkpoint-upload","headers":{},"expiresAt":"2030-01-01T00:00:00Z"}`)
   251			case base + "artifacts/" + artifactID.String() + "/complete":
   252				var input struct {
   253					SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
   254				}
   255				if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&input); err != nil {
   256					http.Error(response, "invalid Artifact complete payload", http.StatusBadRequest)
   257					return
   258				}
   259				state.Lock()
   260				state.order = append(state.order, "checkpoint.artifact.ready")
   261				state.Unlock()
   262				response.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
   263				_, _ = io.WriteString(response, `{"id":"`+artifactID.String()+`","sha256":"`+input.SHA256+`"}`)
   264			case base + "workspace/checkpoints/" + checkpointID.String() + "/ready":
   265				state.Lock()
   266				state.order = append(state.order, "checkpoint.ready")
   267				state.Unlock()
   268				response.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
   269			case base + "start":
   270				state.Lock()
   271				state.order = append(state.order, "execution.start")
   272				state.Unlock()
   273				response.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
   274			case base + "complete":
   275				state.Lock()
   276				state.order = append(state.order, "execution.complete")
   277				state.Unlock()
   278				response.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
   279			default:
   280				http.Error(response, "unexpected path", http.StatusNotFound)
   281			}
   282		}))
   283		defer server.Close()
   284		controlPlaneURL, err := url.Parse(server.URL)
   285		if err != nil {
   286			t.Fatal(err)
   287		}
   288		cfg := Config{
   289			ControlPlaneURL: controlPlaneURL, TargetKind: platform.TargetLocal,
   290			RunnerCommand:  agentdDrainRunnerTestCommand(),
   291			RunnerProtocol: RunnerProtocolV1, WorkspaceRoot: t.TempDir(), PollInterval: time.Millisecond,
   292			HeartbeatInterval: time.Hour, LeaseRenewInterval: time.Hour, DrainTimeout: time.Second,
   293			RequestTimeout: time.Second, ArtifactTimeout: time.Second, RunnerMessageBytes: 1 << 20,
   294		}
   295		client := NewClient(cfg)
   296		client.workerToken = "worker-token"
   297		materializedDirectory := t.TempDir()
   298		daemon := &Daemon{
   299			config: cfg, client: client, runner: NewRunner(cfg),
   300			workspace: workspaceMaterializerInspector{
   301				materialize: func(_ context.Context, _ executions.Execution, _ executions.Workload, credential *WorkspaceGitCredential) (WorkspaceMaterialization, error) {
   302					if credential == nil || credential.HTTPS == nil || credential.SSH != nil ||
   303						credential.HTTPS.Host != "git.example.com" || credential.HTTPS.Username != "git-user" ||
   304						credential.HTTPS.Token != "git-secret-token" {
   305						t.Fatalf("Workspace materializer received an invalid Git Credential: %#v", credential)
   306					}
   307					state.Lock()
   308					state.order = append(state.order, "workspace.materialize")
   309					state.Unlock()
   310					return WorkspaceMaterialization{
   311						Directory: materializedDirectory, Managed: true, RepositoryFingerprint: fingerprint,
   312						CurrentBranch: branch, BaseCommit: baseCommit, HeadCommit: headCommit,
   313					}, nil
   314				},
   315				inspect: func(_ context.Context, _ WorkspaceMaterialization) (WorkspaceInspection, error) {
   316					state.Lock()
   317					state.order = append(state.order, "workspace.inspect")
   318					state.Unlock()
   319					return WorkspaceInspection{Dirty: false}, nil
   320				},
   321			},
   322			logger: slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(io.Discard, nil)),
   323		}
   324		execution := executions.Execution{ID: executionID, TenantID: tenantID, TurnID: uuid.New(), Generation: 1}
   325		workload := executions.Workload{
   326			TenantID: tenantID, OrganizationID: uuid.New(), ProjectID: uuid.New(), SessionID: uuid.New(),
   327			TurnID: execution.TurnID, RemoteWorkspaceID: &workspaceID, Provider: "codex", InputText: "run",
   328			CredentialGrants: []executions.CredentialGrantDescriptor{{
   329				GrantID: gitGrantID, BindingKind: "git_fetch", Purpose: "git", Provider: "git",
   330				CredentialType: "https_token", Selector: "https://git.example.com/team/repository.git",
   331			}},
   332		}
   333		if err := daemon.runExecution(context.Background(), execution, lease, workload, nil); err != nil {
   334			t.Fatal(err)
   335		}
   336		state.Lock()
   337		defer state.Unlock()
   338		expectedOrder := []string{
   339			"git.resolve", "workspace.materialize", "workspace.ready", "execution.start",
   340			"workspace.inspect", "workspace.dirty", "checkpoint.create", "checkpoint.artifact.create",
   341			"checkpoint.upload", "checkpoint.artifact.ready", "checkpoint.ready", "execution.complete",
   342		}
   343		if len(state.order) != len(expectedOrder) {
   344			t.Fatalf("unexpected Workspace/Execution lifecycle order: %#v", state.order)
   345		}
   346		for index := range expectedOrder {
   347			if state.order[index] != expectedOrder[index] {
   348				t.Fatalf("unexpected Workspace/Execution lifecycle order: %#v", state.order)
   349			}
   350		}
   351		if state.ready.RepositoryFingerprint == nil || *state.ready.RepositoryFingerprint != *fingerprint ||
   352			state.ready.CurrentBranch == nil || *state.ready.CurrentBranch != *branch {
   353			t.Fatalf("Workspace metadata was not reported: %#v", state.ready)
   354		}
   355		if state.dirty.CurrentBranch != nil || state.dirty.HeadCommit != nil {
   356			t.Fatalf("empty non-Git Workspace reported Git metadata: %#v", state.dirty)
   357		}
   358		if state.checkpoint.Strategy != "snapshot" {
   359			t.Fatalf("empty non-Git Workspace did not use a Snapshot Checkpoint: %#v", state.checkpoint)
   360		}
   361		if strings.Contains(strings.Join(state.requestBodies, "\n"), "git-secret-token") {
   362			t.Fatal("Git Credential leaked into an agentd request after resolution")
   363		}
   364	}

   366	func TestDaemonReportsManagedWorkspaceFailureBeforeFailingExecution(t *testing.T) {
   367		executionID := uuid.New()
   368		tenantID := uuid.New()
   369		workerID := uuid.New()
   370		workspaceID := uuid.New()
   371		lease := executions.Lease{
   372			ExecutionID: executionID, TenantID: tenantID, WorkerID: workerID,
   373			Generation: 1, LeaseToken: "lease-token", ExpiresAt: time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
   374		}
   375		var state struct {
   376			sync.Mutex
   377			order  []string
   378			failed executions.WorkspaceFailedInput
   379		}
   380		server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(response http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
   381			base := "/v1/workers/executions/" + executionID.String() + "/"
   382			switch request.URL.Path {
   383			case base + "workspace/failed":
   384				var input executions.WorkspaceFailedInput
   385				if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&input); err != nil {
   386					http.Error(response, "invalid Workspace failure payload", http.StatusBadRequest)
   387					return
   388				}
   389				state.Lock()
   390				state.failed = input
   391				state.order = append(state.order, "workspace.failed")
   392				state.Unlock()
   393				response.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
   394			case base + "fail":
   395				state.Lock()
   396				state.order = append(state.order, "execution.fail")
   397				state.Unlock()
   398				response.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
   399			default:
   400				http.Error(response, "unexpected path", http.StatusNotFound)
   401			}
   402		}))
   403		defer server.Close()
   404		controlPlaneURL, err := url.Parse(server.URL)
   405		if err != nil {
   406			t.Fatal(err)
   407		}
   408		cfg := Config{
   409			ControlPlaneURL: controlPlaneURL, TargetKind: platform.TargetLocal,
   410			RunnerCommand: []string{"unused"}, RunnerProtocol: RunnerProtocolV1, WorkspaceRoot: t.TempDir(),
   411			PollInterval: time.Millisecond, HeartbeatInterval: time.Hour, LeaseRenewInterval: time.Hour,
   412			DrainTimeout: time.Second, RequestTimeout: time.Second, ArtifactTimeout: time.Second, RunnerMessageBytes: 1 << 20,
   413		}
   414		client := NewClient(cfg)
   415		client.workerToken = "worker-token"
   416		daemon := &Daemon{
   417			config: cfg, client: client, runner: NewRunner(cfg),
   418			workspace: workspaceMaterializerFunc(func(context.Context, executions.Execution, executions.Workload, *WorkspaceGitCredential) (WorkspaceMaterialization, error) {
   419				return WorkspaceMaterialization{}, workspaceFailure(
   420					"workspace_invalid", "Repository URL is not allowed for a remote Workspace.", true, false,
   421				)
   422			}),
   423			logger: slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(io.Discard, nil)),
   424		}
   425		execution := executions.Execution{ID: executionID, TenantID: tenantID, TurnID: uuid.New(), Generation: 1}
   426		workload := executions.Workload{
   427			TenantID: tenantID, OrganizationID: uuid.New(), ProjectID: uuid.New(), SessionID: uuid.New(),
   428			TurnID: execution.TurnID, RemoteWorkspaceID: &workspaceID, Provider: "codex", InputText: "run",
   429		}
   430		if err := daemon.runExecution(context.Background(), execution, lease, workload, nil); err == nil {
   431			t.Fatal("Workspace preparation failure did not fail the Execution")
   432		}
   433		state.Lock()
   434		defer state.Unlock()
   435		if len(state.order) != 2 || state.order[0] != "workspace.failed" || state.order[1] != "execution.fail" {
   436			t.Fatalf("unexpected Workspace failure order: %#v", state.order)
   437		}
   438		if state.failed.FailureCode != "workspace_invalid" || state.failed.FailureMessage == "" {
   439			t.Fatalf("Workspace failure was not safely classified: %#v", state.failed)
   440		}
   441	}

   464	) (WorkspaceMaterialization, error) {
   465		return m.materialize(ctx, execution, workload, credential)
   466	}

    86		workspaceRoot := t.TempDir()
    87		cacheRoot := t.TempDir()
    88		targetID := uuid.New()
    89		execution, workload := workspaceTestWorkload(targetID)
    90		materializer := NewWorkspaceMaterializerWithCache(workspaceRoot, cacheRoot, targetID)
    91		materializer.resolver = workspaceResolver{"git.example.com": {{IP: net.ParseIP("93.184.216.34")}}}
    92		var observedCommands []string
    93		networkFetches := configureWorkspaceTestNetwork(t, materializer, createWorkspaceTestSource(t), func(_ string, _ []string, arguments []string) {
    94			observedCommands = append(observedCommands, strings.Join(arguments, " "))
    95		})
    96	
    97		first, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
    98		if err != nil {
    99			t.Fatal(err)
   100		}
   101		if !first.Managed || first.LogicalRoot == "" || first.GitDir == "" || first.Directory != filepath.Join(first.LogicalRoot, "checkout") {
   102			t.Fatalf("unexpected private Workspace materialization: %#v", first)
   103		}
   104		gitFileInfo, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(first.Directory, ".git"))
   105		if err != nil || !gitFileInfo.Mode().IsRegular() || gitFileInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
   106			t.Fatalf("checkout .git is not a regular gitfile: info=%v err=%v", gitFileInfo, err)
   107		}
   108		commonDir := strings.TrimSpace(runTestGitOutput(t, first.Directory, "rev-parse", "--git-common-dir"))
   109		if !sameExistingPath(commonDir, first.GitDir) {
   110			t.Fatalf("checkout common-dir is not private: %s != %s", commonDir, first.GitDir)
   111		}
   112		firstDirectory := first.Directory
   113		if err := first.Release(); err != nil {
   114			t.Fatal(err)
   115		}
   116	
   117		second, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
   118		if err != nil {
   119			t.Fatal(err)
   120		}
   121		if second.Directory != firstDirectory || networkFetches.Load() != 2 {
   122			t.Fatalf("warm Workspace was not reused with a fresh Fetch: directory=%s fetches=%d", second.Directory, networkFetches.Load())
   123		}
   124		if err := second.Release(); err != nil {
   125			t.Fatal(err)
   126		}
   127	
   128		encodedCommands := strings.Join(observedCommands, "\n")
   129		for _, forbidden := range []string{"clone --local", "clone --shared", "clone --reference"} {
   130			if strings.Contains(encodedCommands, forbidden) {
   131				t.Fatalf("private Git materialization used forbidden local sharing flag %s: %s", forbidden, encodedCommands)
   132			}
   133		}
   134		if !strings.Contains(encodedCommands, "protocol.file.allow=always") || !strings.Contains(encodedCommands, "file://") {
   135			t.Fatalf("private Git materialization did not use controlled file transport: %s", encodedCommands)
   136		}
   137		if err := rejectGitObjectAlternates(second.GitDir); err != nil {
   138			t.Fatal(err)
   139		}
   140		if err := os.RemoveAll(cacheRoot); err != nil {
   141			t.Fatal(err)
   142		}
   143		runTestGit(t, second.Directory, "cat-file", "-e", "HEAD^{commit}")
   144	}

   146	func TestWorkspaceLockCoversConcurrentTurns(t *testing.T) {
   147		workspaceRoot := t.TempDir()
   148		cacheRoot := t.TempDir()
   149		targetID := uuid.New()
   150		execution, workload := workspaceTestWorkload(targetID)
   151		materializer := NewWorkspaceMaterializerWithCache(workspaceRoot, cacheRoot, targetID)

   153		configureWorkspaceTestNetwork(t, materializer, createWorkspaceTestSource(t), nil)
   154		first, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
   155		if err != nil {
   156			t.Fatal(err)
   157		}
   158		type result struct {
   159			materialized WorkspaceMaterialization
   160			err          error
   161		}
   162		resultChannel := make(chan result, 1)
   163		go func() {
   164			materialized, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
   165			resultChannel <- result{materialized: materialized, err: err}
   166		}()
   167		select {
   168		case outcome := <-resultChannel:
   169			t.Fatalf("second Turn entered the Workspace before release: %v", outcome.err)
   170		case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
   171		}
   172		if err := first.Release(); err != nil {
   173			t.Fatal(err)
   174		}
   175		select {
   176		case outcome := <-resultChannel:
   177			if outcome.err != nil {
   178				t.Fatal(outcome.err)
   179			}
   180			_ = outcome.materialized.Release()
   181		case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
   182			t.Fatal("second Turn did not acquire the released Workspace lock")
   183		}
   184	}

   224		workspaceRoot := t.TempDir()
   225		cacheRoot := t.TempDir()
   226		targetID := uuid.New()
   227		execution, workload := workspaceTestWorkload(targetID)

   230		networkFetches := configureWorkspaceTestNetwork(t, materializer, createWorkspaceTestSource(t), nil)
   230		networkFetches := configureWorkspaceTestNetwork(t, materializer, createWorkspaceTestSource(t), nil)
   231	
   232		first, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
   233		if err != nil {
   234			t.Fatal(err)
   235		}
   236		cache := first.cache
   237		if err := first.Release(); err != nil {
   238			t.Fatal(err)
   239		}
   240	
   241		backup := filepath.Join(cache.Root, ".repo.git.backup-"+uuid.NewString())
   242		staging := filepath.Join(cache.Root, ".repo.git.staging-"+uuid.NewString())
   243		if err := os.Rename(cache.RepoGit, backup); err != nil {
   244			t.Fatal(err)
   245		}
   246		if err := os.Mkdir(staging, 0o700); err != nil {
   247			t.Fatal(err)
   248		}
   249		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(staging, "partial"), []byte("not committed\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
   250			t.Fatal(err)
   251		}
   252	
   253		second, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
   254		if err != nil {
   255			t.Fatal(err)
   256		}
   257		defer second.Release()

   259			t.Fatalf("restored Git cache is invalid: %v", err)
   260		}
   261		for _, residue := range []string{backup, staging} {
   262			if _, err := os.Lstat(residue); !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
   263				t.Fatalf("Git cache reconciliation left residue %s: %v", residue, err)
   264			}
   265		}
   266		if networkFetches.Load() != 2 {
   267			t.Fatalf("restored Git cache was not refreshed: fetches=%d", networkFetches.Load())
   268		}
   269	}

   313	func TestWorkspaceCacheReconciliationCancellationPreservesCommittedBackup(t *testing.T) {
   314		workspaceRoot := t.TempDir()
   315		cacheRoot := t.TempDir()
   316		targetID := uuid.New()
   317		execution, workload := workspaceTestWorkload(targetID)
   318		materializer := NewWorkspaceMaterializerWithCache(workspaceRoot, cacheRoot, targetID)
   319		materializer.resolver = workspaceResolver{"git.example.com": {{IP: net.ParseIP("93.184.216.34")}}}
   320		configureWorkspaceTestNetwork(t, materializer, createWorkspaceTestSource(t), nil)
   321	
   322		first, err := materializer.Materialize(context.Background(), execution, workload, nil)
   323		if err != nil {
   324			t.Fatal(err)
   325		}
   326		cache := first.cache
   327		if err := first.Release(); err != nil {
   328			t.Fatal(err)
   329		}
   330	
   331		backup := filepath.Join(cache.Root, ".repo.git.backup-"+uuid.NewString())
   332		staging := filepath.Join(cache.Root, ".repo.git.staging-"+uuid.NewString())
   333		if err := os.Rename(cache.RepoGit, backup); err != nil {
   334			t.Fatal(err)
   335		}
   336		if err := os.Mkdir(staging, 0o700); err != nil {
   337			t.Fatal(err)
   338		}
   339		sentinel := filepath.Join(backup, "preserve-on-cancel")
   340		if err := os.WriteFile(sentinel, []byte("preserve\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
   341			t.Fatal(err)
   342		}
   343	
   344		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
   345		originalRunGit := materializer.runGit
   346		materializer.runGit = func(
   347			commandContext context.Context,
   348			directory string,
   349			environment []string,
   350			arguments ...string,
   351		) (string, error) {
   352			cancel()
   353			return originalRunGit(commandContext, directory, environment, arguments...)
   354		}
   355		err = materializer.reconcileCacheRepository(ctx, cache, *workload.RepositoryURL)
   356		if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
   357			t.Fatalf("canceled Git cache reconciliation returned %v", err)
   358		}
   359		if content, err := os.ReadFile(sentinel); err != nil || string(content) != "preserve\n" {
   360			t.Fatalf("canceled reconciliation deleted the committed backup: %q, %v", content, err)
   361		}
   362		if _, err := os.Lstat(staging); err != nil {
   363			t.Fatalf("canceled reconciliation deleted orphan staging before a safe decision: %v", err)
   364		}
   365	}

     1	# Remote Workspace and Checkpoint contract v1
     2	
     3	Remote Workspace v1 separates the logical Session Workspace from any disposable Worker filesystem path.
     4	PostgreSQL owns identity and lifecycle metadata; Git and ready Artifact payloads own recoverable content; a Worker
     5	checkout is only a cache.
     6	
     7	The DDL source of truth is the forward migration chain under `services/control-plane/migrations/` (the core
     8	Workspace/Checkpoint tables arrived in `000020`–`000027` and later migrations extend them); published migrations
     9	are never rewritten in place.
    10	
    11	## Identity and states
    12	
    13	Each Agent Session has at most one `remote_workspaces` row. It is scoped by Tenant, Organization, Project,
    14	Session and Execution Target and never stores a host path, Repository Credential or embedded Credential URL.
    15	
    16	Workspace states are:
    17	
    18	```text
    19	pending -> preparing -> ready -> dirty -> checkpointing
    20	                    \-> recovering
    21	pending/ready/dirty/recovering -> cleanup-pending -> cleaned
    22	any active preparation state -> failed
    23	```
    24	
    25	Changing the Session Execution Target moves the logical Workspace to `recovering`; it does not reuse a mutable
    26	checkout from the previous Target.
    27	
    28	## Execution binding
    29	
    30	Every new Turn ensures the Session has one Runtime Binding and one logical Workspace. The resulting Execution
    31	stores `provider_runtime_binding_id` and `remote_workspace_id`. Claim records the current Worker Manifest,
    32	Worker/Generation and last-use time before Provider work begins. Database constraint triggers reject a Runtime
    33	Binding or Workspace from another Session, Provider, Tenant or Execution Target.
    34	
    35	Agentd materializes a managed checkout at a stable path derived from Execution Target, Tenant, Project, Session
    36	and logical Workspace IDs. The path no longer includes the current Execution ID, so a later Turn on the same
    37	Target reuses the Session checkout. The Provider receives only the `checkout` directory; PostgreSQL never stores
    38	that path.
    39	
    40	The Worker-local layout is versioned and keeps disposable shared Git objects separate from the private mutable
    41	Workspace generation:
    42	
    43	```text
    44	GIT_CACHE_ROOT/
    45	  v1/<target>/<tenant>/<project>/<repository-fingerprint>/repo.git
    46	
    47	WORKSPACE_ROOT/
    48	  .locks/...
    49	  v3/<target>/<tenant>/<project>/<session>/<workspace>/<materialization-incarnation>/
    50	    manifest.json
    51	    repo.git
    52	    checkout/
    53	```
    54	
    55	Layout v3 binds a logical materialization ID to an immutable physical incarnation ID. Every new managed
    56	materialization uses v3; layout v2 is adoption-only for an existing row explicitly migrated by Control Plane and
    57	is never inferred from omitted v3 fields. Worker Protocol v2 carries both identities and rejects a downgrade.
    58	
    59	The cache is a bare, read-only materialization input from the Provider's perspective. Agentd takes a cross-process
    60	cache lock and performs a credential-authorized network Fetch on every Turn, so a warm cache cannot bypass a
    61	revoked Credential. It then Fetches through an explicitly enabled, controlled `file://` transport into the
    62	Workspace-private `repo.git` and creates a relative linked worktree under `checkout`. The private repository must
    63	not use hardlinks, alternates, `--shared`, `--reference*`, or the shared cache as its Git common directory. Deleting
    64	or rebuilding the cache therefore cannot corrupt an existing dirty Workspace.
    65	
    66	One cross-process Workspace lock is held from materialization through Provider exit, final inspection,
    67	Checkpoint creation and the terminal Complete/Fail/Release attempt. Lock ordering is always Workspace then cache.
    68	The generation Manifest and linked-worktree metadata are revalidated before reuse or restore: `manifest.json`,
    69	`checkout/.git`, `commondir`, `gitdir`, the private `repo.git` and all ancestors are checked. All directories must
    70	be non-symlink directories below the configured Workspace root and all metadata files must be bounded regular files.
    71	Absolute or escaping metadata paths, symlinks and object alternates are rejected.
    72	
    73	Workspace preparation happens while the claimed Lease is being renewed and before `execution.started`:
    74	
    75	1. Create and verify each Workspace path component without following symlinks.
    76	2. Validate the Repository URL, default branch and repository fingerprint.
    77	3. Under the cache lock, Fetch the default branch from the validated network remote on every Turn; atomically
    78	   rebuild a missing or corrupt bare cache.
    79	4. Build or validate a Workspace-private bare repository and relative linked worktree without shared object
    80	   storage, then Fetch the requested ref from the controlled cache input.
    81	5. Create/restore a deterministic `synara/session-<session-id>` branch when the checkout is still on the default branch.
    82	6. Read the current branch, merge base and HEAD and revalidate the private Git metadata.
    83	7. Report `workspace.ready` under the current Worker/Generation, then start the Provider.
    84	
    85	Preparation failure reports `workspace.failed` and fails the Execution with a stable `workspace_invalid` code.
    86	The ready/failed endpoints are idempotent and Generation-fenced; an obsolete Worker cannot overwrite state from
    87	the replacement Worker.
    88	
    89	After Provider execution, agentd inspects the checkout again while the Lease is still being renewed. A changed
    90	tracked/untracked Git checkout, or any generated content in a managed non-Git Workspace, is reported through
    91	the idempotent Generation-fenced `workspace.dirty` endpoint before Execution completion. The Control Plane
    92	persists the latest branch/HEAD and appends `workspace.dirty`; an obsolete Generation cannot mark or overwrite
    93	the replacement Worker's Workspace state. Unsafe Git configuration discovered after Provider execution fails
    94	the Execution instead of being accepted as a recoverable state.
    95	
    96	## Repository network policy
    97	
    98	The managed remote implementation accepts HTTPS repositories on the default HTTPS port. It rejects embedded
    99	Userinfo, query strings, fragments, non-HTTPS schemes, ambiguous paths, localhost, private, loopback,
   100	link-local, multicast and unspecified addresses. All resolved addresses must be public.
   101	
   102	Network Git commands pin the validated address with `http.curloptResolve` and disable HTTP redirects, closing
   103	the DNS-rebinding and redirect-to-metadata-service gaps between validation and Clone/Fetch. Git runs without
   104	ambient Credential helpers, SSH Agent, global/system Git config or LFS smudge downloads. Repository URLs with
   105	embedded Credentials are never accepted or persisted.
   106	
   107	Workspace Credential ownership is modeled by immutable `credential_bindings`, not by a mutable secret field on a
   108	Project. Project stages use `git_fetch`, `git_push`, `registry_pull`, `registry_push`, `package_read` and
   109	`package_publish`; Execution Targets use the separate `worker_image_pull` infrastructure stage. A Binding owns one
   110	normalized non-secret selector and can only transition once from active to disabled. Claim creates a new immutable
   111	Generation-fenced Grant for each active Project Binding. Claim receipt replay reuses those Grant IDs, while recovery
   112	creates new Grants and snapshots the then-current Credential versions. Workload and Worker resolve APIs expose the
   113	Grant descriptor, never the underlying Credential ID or version.
   114	
   115	Private HTTPS uses a Project-bound, purpose-isolated `git/https_token` Credential. Agentd resolves it only for
   116	the current Worker, Lease and Generation and exposes it to Git through an ephemeral Unix-socket AskPass helper.
   117	The helper accepts only Username/Password prompts containing the exact validated Repository hostname. The
   118	username/token are not placed in argv, the Repository URL, ordinary environment variables or the Workspace,
   119	and the socket is removed immediately after Clone/Fetch. Fetch rejects a checkout whose local `.git/config`
   120	contains Credential helpers, AskPass, hooks, SSH commands, proxy/extra headers, URL rewrites, includes, filters,
   121	or remote upload/receive command overrides.
   122	
   123	Private SSH uses a Project-bound `git/ssh_key` Credential through the short-lived SSH Agent contract in
   124	[Worker Protocol v2](worker-protocol-v2.md): the `ssh://user@host[:port]/path` repository must match the Grant
   125	selector, DNS answers must be public and the selected IP is pinned, the stored Host Key is fixed, and exactly one
   126	private key is loaded into a temporary agent socket that is removed immediately after Clone/Fetch. The private key
   127	and passphrase never enter the Workspace, argv, ordinary environment, Git config, or Provider input. Ambient
   128	`SSH_AUTH_SOCK`, SSH config, ProxyCommand, and host credential stores are not inherited; agentd never falls back
   129	to host credentials or interactive login.
   130	
   131	## Checkpoints
   132	
   133	A Checkpoint uses a stable idempotency key and one strategy:
   134	
   135	```text
   136	git-reference | patch | snapshot
   137	```
   138	
   139	Patch and snapshot payloads are Artifacts. A Checkpoint cannot become `ready` unless the referenced Artifact is
   140	also `ready`, belongs to the same Session/Execution, has kind `checkpoint` or `workspace_snapshot`, and has the
   141	same SHA-256. The Artifact also carries an immutable reverse `workspace_checkpoint_id` binding, so upload retry,
   142	retention and deletion can identify the owning recovery point without inspecting object keys. Failed Checkpoints
   143	never replace `remote_workspaces.current_checkpoint_id`.
   144	
   145	Agentd creates Checkpoints automatically after Provider execution while the Lease is still current. A clean Git
   146	checkout uses `git-reference`; dirty Git uses a bounded deterministic Patch; managed non-Git content uses a
   147	bounded deterministic Snapshot of regular files.
   148	
   149	A Patch is generated from `baseCommit` to the final Worktree with binary/full-index output and rename detection
   150	disabled. It therefore captures tracked changes introduced by local commits after the base as well as staged,
   151	unstaged, binary, deleted and executable tracked paths. The deterministic tar contains `tracked.patch`, the
   152	final raw bytes or symlink target of every tracked upsert under `tracked/`, and regular untracked files under
   153	`untracked/`. Individually ignored regular files such as `.env` are durable; whole ignored directory trees such
   154	as dependency/tool caches are excluded only when they contain a versioned rebuildable path segment (for example
   155	`node_modules`, `.bun`, `.turbo`, `.venv`, `.next` or `target`). Other ignored directories remain durable and are
   156	enumerated like ordinary untracked content. The Manifest declares the rebuildable exclusion policy so a normal
   157	package install cannot make a Checkpoint unusable or silently redefine durability. Unmerged indexes,
   158	assume-unchanged/skip-worktree/sparse entries, Gitlinks/Submodules, non-reproducible local Git
   159	attributes/configuration and non-regular included untracked files are rejected.
   160	
   161	The `rebuildable-ignored-directory-segments-v1` set is `.astro`, `.bun`, `.gradle`, `.mypy_cache`, `.next`,
   162	`.nuxt`, `.pnpm-store`, `.pytest_cache`, `.ruff_cache`, `.turbo`, `.venv`, `.vite`, `.yarn`, `__pycache__`,
   163	`coverage`, `node_modules`, `target`, `venv`, `.synara`, `.synara-*` and `.vitest-*`.
   164	
   165	Patch restore clones an isolated sibling staging checkout, anchors its branch to `baseCommit`, applies the tracked
   166	Patch to the index, overlays the authoritative raw tracked payload, restores untracked files, and verifies every
   167	path, size, SHA-256, mode, classification, index/worktree consistency and regenerated Patch identity before
   168	replacing the active Workspace. The raw overlay makes a same-Turn `.gitattributes` change reproducible rather
   169	than depending on the base checkout's conversion rules. The restored tracked delta is staged and the untracked
   170	files remain untracked. This contract restores the authoritative file tree and branch name; it does not recreate
   171	local Commit objects or claim that an unpushed source HEAD/Commit graph survived. The installed HEAD is the
   172	available `baseCommit`.
   173	
   174	Snapshot capture excludes `.git`, rejects symlinks/devices/FIFOs/sockets, records a sorted
   175	path/size/SHA-256/executable manifest, and verifies the complete archive again in an isolated staging directory
   176	before replacing a Workspace during restore. Provider execution starts only after the frozen ready Checkpoint
   177	has been downloaded, size/hash verified and restored.
   178	
   179	Checkpoint Artifact creation is deterministic and retryable. The first create transaction binds the Artifact and
   180	moves the Checkpoint to `uploading`. A lost Create/PUT/Complete response reuses the same Artifact; Local upload
   181	tokens rotate, while S3/MinIO re-sign the same temporary key. A ready replay is Lease/Generation-fenced and the
   182	Worker rechecks the local payload metadata before accepting it.
   183	
   184	Expired pending uploads atomically fail their Checkpoint, return the Workspace from `checkpointing` to
   185	`ready`/`dirty`, and preserve the previous current Checkpoint. Retention clears terminal Execution restore
   186	references, expires only non-current/unreferenced Checkpoints, and deletes an Artifact only after no
   187	`pending`/`uploading`/`ready` Checkpoint references it. User deletion returns the stable
   188	`artifact_checkpoint_referenced` conflict while such a reference exists. S3/MinIO temporary upload keys use one
   189	bounded post-expiry cleanup grace pass to catch late presigned PUTs, then leave the sweep permanently.
   190	
   191	## Recovery order
   192	
   193	Recovery prefers:
   194	
   195	1. committed Git reference;
   196	2. ready Patch or Workspace Snapshot Checkpoint;
   197	3. an explicitly reported unrecoverable/data-loss-risk outcome.
   198	
   199	An absent Worker directory is never interpreted as an empty authoritative Workspace.
   200	
   201	## Physical cleanup
   202	
   203	Control Plane creates a durable cleanup command only after the logical Workspace reaches a cleanup-eligible state.
   204	The command carries the exact Target, storage scope, materialization ID, physical incarnation ID and layout version.
   205	Agentd revalidates that complete tuple against the managed root and Manifest before deletion, takes the same
   206	Workspace lock used by execution, refuses symlink/path escape, and deletes only that physical root. Kubernetes
   207	cleanup additionally requires the current Pod UID/Worker incarnation evidence and fails closed when ownership is
   208	ambiguous.
   209	
   210	Cleanup Claim, renew, complete, fail and release are Worker-incarnation and Lease fenced. The scheduler interleaves
   211	cleanup and Execution Claims so cleanup cannot starve ordinary work or monopolize a Worker. A stale Worker,
   212	Generation, layout-v2 inference, or historical physical incarnation cannot acknowledge or delete a replacement
   213	Workspace.
   214	
   215	## Implemented boundary and future scaling
   216	
   217	Stage 3 completes the schema, Session/Execution bindings, public/private HTTPS Clone/Fetch materialization,
   218	Project Git Credential binding, short-lived SSH Agent/Host Key delivery, cross-process locked shared Git cache,
   219	Workspace-private relative `git worktree` generations, Generation-fenced state reporting,
   220	Git-reference/Patch/Snapshot Checkpoint capture/restore, safe Checkpoint/Artifact retention, interrupted
   221	staging/backup reconciliation, and the shared Local/SSH/Docker/Kubernetes acceptance boundary.
   222	
   223	Kubernetes cross-Pod cache sharing still requires an explicitly configured RWX-equivalent PVC; the default cache
   224	remains Pod-local and disposable. This is a Stage 4 capacity/storage scaling option, not a Stage 3 correctness or
   225	release blocker.

    31	  进入 Worker Manifest 与 Recovery Bundle；模板快照按 Release Revision 构建，随 canary/promote/
    32	  rollback 生命周期走现有 Release Policy。
    33	- restore 后的实例是**新的物理 incarnation**：沿用 instanceUid 轮换、Lease 冻结、Generation
    34	  fencing 全套现有语义；内存快照绝不包含 Credential 明文（Grant 在 restore 后重新 resolve），
    35	  也不包含 Workspace 私有 repo 之外的租户数据。
    36	- suspend 侧：quiesce receipt 语义不变，"介质"从对象存储 checkpoint 换为本地/池化内存快照 +
    37	  异步 checkpoint 兜底（快照丢失时回落现有 recovery 路径，fail closed 不重放副作用）。
    38	
    39	## 3. Workspace cache-first
    40	
    41	- Claim 放行条件从"网络 fetch 成功"改为"Grant resolve 成功"（Grant 已是每 Claim 必经、可即时
    42	  吊销的权威）；网络 fetch 转为后台刷新，Session Event 显式携带 `workspaceFreshness:
    43	fresh | stale(<age>)`。
    44	- 凭证吊销后的在途 Turn：下一次 Grant 续期失败即停止 Provider（现有 access broker 语义已覆盖）。
    45	- 物化介质：git-cache/私有 repo 分离结构保持；Kubernetes 增加 volume-snapshot/overlayfs 选项作为
    46	  materialization 加速，不改变 Checkpoint 恢复权威。
    47	
    48	## 4. 双 lane
    49	
    50	- Session 创建时冻结 `lane: interactive | batch`（默认 interactive；Automation 默认 batch）。
    51	- interactive → `snapshot-restore`/`guaranteed-warm`；batch → `cold` + 现有 fairqueue。
    52	- 计费：`provision_tier` 进入 requested-resource-seconds 事实与 tariff（新增
    53	  `snapshot_restore_hour_rate_micros` 等费率列时沿用 append-only tariff 版本化）。
    54	
    55	## 5. 不变式（与现行契约的兼容承诺）
    56	
    57	- Worker Protocol、Runtime Event、Grant、fencing、Checkpoint/Artifact 权威、suspend receipt
    58	  语义全部不变；本提案只新增 Pool mode、completion mode、capability 与 bounded label。
    59	- fail closed 原则不变：快照缺失/身份不符回落 cold 路径或失败，绝不静默降级安全边界。

    27		ctx context.Context,
    28		materialized WorkspaceMaterialization,
    29		checkpoint executions.WorkspaceCheckpoint,
    30		artifactPath string,
    31	) (WorkspaceMaterialization, error) {

    33			return WorkspaceMaterialization{}, workspaceFailure(
    34				"workspace_invalid", "An unmanaged Workspace cannot consume a remote Checkpoint.", true, false,
    35			)
    36		}
    37		switch checkpoint.Strategy {
    38		case "git-reference":
    39			return m.restoreGitReference(ctx, materialized, checkpoint)
    40		case "snapshot":
    41			return m.restoreSnapshot(ctx, materialized, checkpoint, artifactPath)
    42		case "patch":
    43			return m.restorePatch(ctx, materialized, checkpoint, artifactPath)
    44		default:
    45			return WorkspaceMaterialization{}, workspaceFailure(
    46				"workspace_invalid", "The Workspace Checkpoint strategy is unsupported.", true, false,
    47			)
    48		}
    49	}

   203	func writeWorkspaceManifest(root string, manifest workspaceGenerationManifest) error {
   204		if err := validateWorkspaceManifestFormat(manifest); err != nil {
   205			return err
   206		}
   207		encoded, err := json.Marshal(manifest)
   208		if err != nil || len(encoded) > workspaceManifestMaxSize {
   209			return errors.New("Workspace manifest is invalid")
   210		}
   211		temporary, err := os.CreateTemp(root, ".manifest-*.json")
   212		if err != nil {
   213			return err
   214		}
   215		temporaryPath := temporary.Name()
   216		defer os.Remove(temporaryPath)
   217		if err := temporary.Chmod(0o600); err != nil {
   218			_ = temporary.Close()
   219			return err
   220		}
   221		if _, err := temporary.Write(append(encoded, '\n')); err != nil {
   222			_ = temporary.Close()
   223			return err
   224		}
   225		if err := temporary.Sync(); err != nil {
   226			_ = temporary.Close()
   227			return err
   228		}
   229		if err := temporary.Close(); err != nil {
   230			return err
   231		}
   232		return os.Rename(temporaryPath, filepath.Join(root, "manifest.json"))
   233	}

+func (m *WorkspaceMaterializer) cacheFetchIsFresh(
+	ctx context.Context,
+	cache workspaceCacheLayout,
+	repositoryURL, defaultBranch string,
+	requiredCommits []string,
+) bool {
+	if m.fetchFreshnessWindow <= 0 || m.validateBareRepository(ctx, cache.RepoGit, repositoryURL) != nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	marker, err := readSmallRegularFile(cache.FetchMarker, workspaceCacheFetchMarkerMaxSize)
+	if err != nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	fetchedAt, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, strings.TrimSpace(marker))
+	if err != nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	now := time.Now().UTC()
+	if m.now != nil {
+		now = m.now().UTC()
+	}
+	age := now.Sub(fetchedAt)
+	if age < 0 || age >= m.fetchFreshnessWindow {
+		return false
+	}
+	references := append(
+		[]string{"refs/remotes/origin/" + defaultBranch},
+		requiredCommits...,
+	)
+	for _, reference := range references {
+		commit, err := m.runGit(
+			ctx, cache.RepoGit, gitEnvironment(nil), "rev-parse", "--verify", strings.TrimSpace(reference)+"^{commit}",
+		)
+		if err != nil || !validGitObjectID(commit) {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func (m *WorkspaceMaterializer) refreshCacheRepository(
+	ctx context.Context,
+	cache workspaceCacheLayout,
+	remote gitpolicy.Remote,
+	defaultBranch string,
+	credential *WorkspaceGitCredential,
+) error {
+	lock, err := acquireWorkspaceFileLock(ctx, m.cacheRoot, cache.LockPath)
+	if err != nil {
+		return fmt.Errorf("acquire Git cache lock: %w", err)
+	}
+	defer lock.Release()
+	return m.ensureCacheRepository(ctx, cache, remote, defaultBranch, credential)
+}
